subject: Procurement next steps & MPA - Redwood <> Skyline Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Henderson <alex.henderson@skylinehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement next steps & MPA - Redwood <> Skyline Health

Hi Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we all have a single timeline: 

1) Procurement path: please confirm whether you will purchase via PO (preferred for larger engagements) or corporate card, and whether you want to go through your cloud marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace) or direct Redwood invoicing.

2) Docs we shared: attached draft Mutual Action Plan (MPA_SkylineHealth_v1.pdf) and pricing sheet. I also attached a first-pass SOW that outlines scope.

3) Suggested procurement milestones (high-level):
   - Legal review / redlines: 5 business days after receiving draft
   - Security review (questionnaire + evidence): 7–10 business days
   - Finance approval / PO creation: 3–5 business days after approvals
   - PO issuance & account set up: 1–2 business days

If you’re running to a target go-live date, please flag it and we’ll tighten the milestones.

Owners from our side: Marcus Lin will handle contract redlines; Dylan Brooks will coordinate security questionnaire and evidence; I’ll own commercial/finance coordination and follow through on PO setup.

Ask: can you confirm by EOD Monday whether the procurement path is PO vs card and whether you’d like to use marketplace? Once confirmed we’ll lock the MPA and assign dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the MPA locked so we can move to the security review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: MPA_SkylineHealth_v1.pdf

From: Alex Henderson <alex.henderson@skylinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps & MPA - Redwood <> Skyline Health

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few quick items from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement path: we prefer PO for anything > $10k. This engagement will be PO.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer a direct purchase (not via AWS Marketplace) for accounting reasons.
- Timeline: legal review will likely take ~7 business days (we have a standard review queue), security will be coordinated in parallel but may take 10 business days depending on evidence requests, finance/PO typically 3 business days after approvals. So overall probably 3–4 weeks assuming no major redlines.

We reviewed the MPA attachment at a high level — looks good. Could you also send a clean SOW and the finalized pricing sheet? Procurement will need line items to create the PO.

Final note: do you have SOC 2 documentation and a filled security questionnaire? If you can get the questionnaire back within 3 business days we can start security immediately.

Alex Henderson
Director of IT Procurement
Skyline Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Henderson <alex.henderson@skylinehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps & MPA - Redwood <> Skyline Health

Appreciate the clarity, Alex — PO + direct invoicing it is. Attaching: SOW_Skyline_Redwood_draft.docx and redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (clean copy).

On the security front: Dylan will own the questionnaire and has visibility into our SOC 2 report; we can complete the questionnaire and return within 3 business days as long as we have the attached evidence request list answered. Marcus — I’ll ping you separately on a couple of standard contract points (indemnity/limitation language).

Proposed mutual action plan (high level and editable):
- Tue 24 Mar: Redwood returns completed security questionnaire + evidence (owner: Dylan)
- Fri 27 Mar: Redwood returns redlines to MPA/SOW (owner: Marcus)
- Wed 1 Apr: Skyline legal signs off (owner: Skyline Legal)
- Thu 2 Apr: Finance approves and issues PO (owner: Skyline Finance)
- Fri 3 Apr: Redwood provisions account; kickoff scheduled (owner: Marissa)

If those dates work I’ll update the attached MPA with owners/dates. Alex — any blockers from your side for this timeline?

Thanks — attaching docs now.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment: SOW_Skyline_Redwood_draft.docx; redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf
